content.text:
Yes, it's really common at this age. Sudden 2am wakings often show up around 18 to 24 months with a sleep regression, separation worries, or a growth spurt.

Tonight, keep the wake-up boring. Go in, keep the lights off, say very little, and give a quick pat or a few quiet words. Then leave while they're still drowsy so they practice settling on their own.
